bZx is a decentralized finance protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. bZx offers margin trading and lending services without intermediaries.

Compound is a decentralized money market protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Compound allows users to lend and borrow crypto assets against collateral without intermediaries.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Uniswap uses automated market maker liquidity pools instead of an order book.

MakerDAO is a decentralized lending protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. MakerDAO issues the DAI stablecoin backed by collateral locked in smart contracts. MakerDAO is governed by holders of its MKR token.
